continuousVoicePolicy: The microphone starts only after runtime permission and explicit destination confirmation. Each turn uses the frozen role, space, chat and speech endpoints; interruption cancels the current network or playback operation. PCM and WAV bytes remain in memory.
limitations: Static APK entry scan in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore, microphone routing and live provider traffic require a connected device.
